title: Cleanup: Reset stale worktrees to main HEAD
description:
## Summary
Reset stale leader worktrees that have uncommitted changes duplicating work already committed on main.

## Current State (verified 2026-02-04)
| Worktree | Commit | Behind Main | Uncommitted Changes | Worker | Status |
|----------|--------|-------------|---------------------|--------|--------|
| groomer-workspace | ac32135 | 12 | logs pkg octal/style fixes | juliet | ACTIVE |
| planner-workspace | 6e33c25 | 14 | logs pkg octal/style fixes | charlie | IDLE |
| reviewer-workspace | 1ada0a7 | 23 | NONE (clean) | echo | ACTIVE |

## Root Cause
Workers made octal formatting fixes (`0755` → `0o755`) in their worktrees that were also committed to main via other tasks (commits 7766082, a335409). Now some worktrees have stale uncommitted changes matching main.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] planner-workspace reset to main HEAD (can do now - charlie is idle)
- [ ] reviewer-workspace reset to main HEAD (wait for echo to finish)
- [ ] groomer-workspace reset to main HEAD (wait for juliet to finish)
- [ ] All leader worktrees on main HEAD with clean status
- [ ] Workers can be reassigned without git conflicts

## Technical Approach
For IDLE worktrees (planner-workspace - safe now):
```bash
cd .forge/worktrees/planner-workspace
git checkout -- .
git checkout main
```

For ACTIVE worktrees (wait for session to complete):
1. Let session complete naturally, OR
2. Stop worker first: `foundry worker stop <name>`
3. Then reset worktree as above

Alternative (nuclear option):
```bash
git worktree remove .forge/worktrees/<workspace> --force
git worktree add .forge/worktrees/<workspace> main
```

## Dependencies
- None (standalone cleanup task)

## Priority Rationale
Low priority - worktrees function fine, just have stale state. Changes don't affect functionality, only cause git status confusion. Can be done incrementally as workers become idle.
